entry.title: Bill 192 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): Passed Second Reading → Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 19, ARTICLE 11, SECTION 19-90 OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAX

Extends the requirement to appropriate residential tier-two and tier-three property tax revenue to the housing and homelessness fund until 2029; requires that monies from the fund be used to award grants that address housing and homelessness.

Status: Passed Second Reading → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Bill 192, Draft 3 passes second & final reading - 10/21/2026

entry.title: Bill 191 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): Passed Second Reading → Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 10, ARTICLE 1, SECTION 10-8 OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO EROSION AND SEDIMENTATION CONTROL

Establishes administrative enforcement provisions for violations of Chapter 10, including increased fines of up to $1,000 per day.

Status: Passed Second Reading → Adopted
